additional_info.subject: Handover to ES
additional_info.body:
a) Problem Description: 0kW charging session seen. Session seen only once on 03/03/25. In the OCPP logs on SCB, we see that the meterStart and meterStop transcation values are exactly the same 29587869 for the charging session.
b) Suspected Root Cause: Charger FW on 6.1.2, also we see that just before the charging session ended. We saw an LEM related log, which is suspected to be the reason for the 0kW session:
{"stack":"Error: PUT
http://10.20.17.20/v2/legal?transactionId=92674d2640ec4177
returned: 412 - Precondition Failed\n at /dist/services/lem-meter.js:418:19\n at Generator.next (<anonymous>)\n at fulfilled (/dist/services/lem-meter.js:5:58)\n at process.processTicksAndRejections (node:internal/process/task_queues:95:5)"}
c) Action Performed: Log analysis
d) Charger SW Version: 6.1.2
e) Reason for Handover: Troubleshooting / We dont have enough information to process cases on 6.1.2 issues.
f) Fault history: NA
g) Log analysis with timestamp:
2025-03-03, 10:56:41 For meterStart
2025-03-03, 11:15:56 for meterStop
and LEM error.
h) Action Required: Troublshooting.
i) Attachment: log screenshots in the agent notes.
